2. Mr. Patankar, the learned Advocate appearing for Nashik Municipal Corporation submitted that this letter was received by the Corporation only on 6th September, 2023.

He submitted that though a preliminary reply is given on 8th September, 2023, the Assistant Director of Town Planning of the Nashik Municipal Corporation will give his comments on the said proposal including compensation roughly calculated by the State within a period of three weeks from today.
We accept the said statement as an undertaking to this Court.
3. We place the above matter on board on 3rd October, 2023, under the same caption.
4. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.

[ M. M.
SATHAYE, J.] [ B. P. COLABAWALLA, J.]
